bonusSpinContract.emptyOutcomePolicy: Uses the approved normal Power pool, including None if configured. The user guarantees an extra spin, not a power regardless of result.
bonusSpinContract.sequence: Main Power acquisition and immediate details -> pending bonus acquisitions and details -> mastery for all unresolved owned powers -> Weakness.
bonusSpinContract.idempotence: One stable source ticket consumed atomically with its actual bonus result; retries never add another spin.

masteryBonusContract.status: User confirmed +2 applies to every owned power; rank-step interpretation and final scale remain design details
masteryBonusContract.unit: ordered mastery rank steps (proposed interpretation; final rank scale pending)
masteryBonusContract.timing: Register the original authorized source modifier once when earned. Resolve raw mastery/Resilient at the ordinary scheduled stage; calculate this bonus only in final bonus phase from the retained immutable base, never at the earlier draw.
masteryBonusContract.formula: sharedEffectiveMasteryScore = retainedSharedRawScore + 2 + sum(other distinct applicable shared mastery modifiers)
masteryBonusContract.scale: Raw mastery scale0..9; final score signed/unbounded under stat-scales/0.2.0.
masteryBonusContract.provenance: Committed Fairy King source modifier and the one shared character mastery invocation; individual power grants retain their own provenance.
masteryBonusContract.idempotence: A distinct source modifier changes the shared rank once. Owning more powers, reevaluation and media retries do not multiply +2.
masteryBonusContract.inventory: No owned power means no mastery roll or phantom power. Keep the main and extra acquisition stages even when the modifier is registered.
masteryBonusContract.enchantment: Never opens enchantment; this affects Power Mastery only.
masteryBonusContract.baseResult: Keep rolled mastery unchanged and show rolled-to-effective rank in context/final card.
masteryBonusContract.scopeSource: User answered: Semua power yang dimiliki
masteryBonusContract.qualifies: One shared ordinary Power Mastery projection covers all owned powers. An actual God Authority uses its source-bound base9 plus the same final shared modifiers; the override never transfers by matching definition.
masteryBonusContract.lateActivation: Register new source as pending. Before final phase do not project; within final phase refresh from the same retained immutable base plus current distinct sources, preserving God instance overrides. No mastery redraw or compounded bonus.
masteryBonusContract.stacking: This fixed Fairy King modifier is active once per character; replaying the same source or repeating evaluation cannot make +4/+6. Additional independent mastery modifiers require their own declared stacking rules.
